text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!
choice_data_list:
What's up? Did you find a race that caught 
your eye?

What's wrong? Did you find a race you're 
interested in?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, rather... an elementary schooler 
gave this to me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was unfolded was a school newspaper 
overflowing with a handmade feel.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...That's her column.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they've been following me 
ever since my debut race—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
They even wrote about the 
open-to-the-public mock races and my solo 
training by the riverbed...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
They said... that my "Genesis Method"... 
was c-cool, too...
choice_data_list: You really love Chrono, don't you?
You really love Chrono, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: T-That's... right, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...'The author also hopes to one day 
become like Chrono Genesis-shi', huh..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"She, too, saw the drama in her 
predecessor... in my back, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My heart grew overwhelmingly hot, and I 
couldn't take my eyes off even a single 
movement of her running on the turfâ

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: She wants to follow in their footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...While I feel a great sense of awe, more 
than that, I feel proud.
choice_data_list:
For that child's sake too, let's keep 
doing our best!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Yearning for my predecessors, I chase in 
their footsteps... and behind me, new 
hoofprints are carved as well..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That is... racing history.

text_block_list.name: Girl Who Gave Newspaper
text_block_list.text: Ah! Chrono-san!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the newspaper the 
other day. It was a wonderful article.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll run a race worthy of getting another 
column written about me, so... um...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The history that I will weave... Please 
keep watching over it!
